events.title: BASIS x BIIANCO/ FREE Community Production Class
events.description:
UTRECHT 💋 BIIANCO is coming for you!
Before she takes over the booth to play on 𝗙𝗿𝗶𝗱𝗮𝘆, 𝗢𝗰𝘁𝗼𝗯𝗲𝗿 𝟭𝟲, artist and producer BIIANCO hosts a 𝙁𝙍𝙀𝙀 𝙥𝙧𝙤𝙙𝙪𝙘𝙩𝙞𝙤𝙣 𝙘𝙡𝙖𝙨𝙨 in the heart of club BASIS. She’d love to see you there, especially if you’re part of Utrecht’s FLINTA+ community 🫶

We really want to make this as accessible as possible, create some space to learn together, and hopefully inspire more of the community to get behind the decks, into production, and make some fucking noise. 💻✨

The class is completely FREE for our communities.
And we’re not running off straight after… stick around for some pre-drinks + a little Q&A before we open BASIS together. 🍸

📝 𝗦𝗜𝗚𝗡 𝗨𝗣 𝗛𝗘𝗥𝗘

📍 BASIS, Utrecht
📅 Friday, October 16
🎛️ Free production class // 21:00-22:30
🍸 Pre-drinks + Q&A afterwards // 22:30-23:30

Come learn, hang, ask questions, meet each other & then LET’S DANCE. 💋
See you there,
BIIANCO 🤍

events.title: BASIS/ AREA ØNE/ BIIANCO/ Hurts/ Nick Selter
events.description:
For the first time ever, we welcome BIIANCO to BASIS!

The American producer, DJ and multi-instrumentalist is a true musical all-rounder. From piano, bass and drums to vocals, synths and modular gear, BIIANCO’s craft is rooted in a deep technical understanding of music and a hands-on approach to sound.
Joining her are the ever-talented and dear friends of the club, AREA ØNE, and Hurts. Completing the lineup is last year’s Talent Night alumnus, Nick Selter.

Get ready for a bouncy night in the basement on 𝗙𝗿𝗶𝗱𝗮𝘆, 𝗢𝗰𝘁𝗼𝗯𝗲𝗿 𝟭𝟲 and see you on the dancefloor!

events.title: BASIS x Le Guess Who? // Listening Session U? / … curated by Perry Gits
events.description:
U?, the freely accessible city program of Le Guess Who?, celebrates local and creative communities. Rooted in Utrecht’s cultural and creative diversity, the festival presents live performances, exhibitions, communal dinners, talks, participatory formats, and educational activities that foster social connection.
 
This year, U? once again opens up space for individuals and collectives who are closely connected to a community to step into a curatorial role. On Sunday, November 08, Perry Gits presents a freely accessible program at BASIS that fosters artistic development, sonic exploration, and underrepresented voices within ambient, live and experimental music

// Doors open from 2PM – 9PM
// FREE ENTRANCE
// More info: https://leguesswho.com/u/
